verdict.rationale: Postmark's developer docs list official libraries for TypeScript, Python, Rails, Ruby, .NET, Java and PHP. Its llms.txt adds an AI-oriented TypeScript path covering install, shared client, template sends, batch handling and webhook validation, so an AI-native user can build against first-party SDKs. missing for 10: in-depth documentation evidence for the non-TypeScript SDKs, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
